collection.title: Honda Accord Saloon 2003 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Honda Accord Saloon 2003 to 2008 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. We list the newer Retrofit blades for this model only as after market Standard blades do not lay perfectly flat on the windscreen.
